buildRating.scope: Equipment and purchased build power, not player skill. Normalize each role against its own baseline.

brutal.endlessTrigger: A completed Standard identity returns Brutal; after a completed Brutal appearance it returns Crazed.

endless.rewards: Completed-encounter mastery, cosmetics and local streak records. Power purchases stop at their normal caps.

difficulties.name: Insane
difficulties.unlock: Complete any full campaign route on Hard.

difficulties.name: Hellish
difficulties.unlock: Complete any full campaign route on Hard.

modes.name: Quarantine Run
modes.description: A five-contract passage from the breached gate to the drowned seat of government.

modes.name: Midnight Circuit
modes.description: The full city circuit, balancing build development with a compact evening session.

modes.name: Black Bell Pilgrimage
modes.description: A longer rescue pilgrimage through all districts, with champions and additional survivor testimony.

modes.name: Grand Raid
modes.description: Three extended encounters with an accelerated starting build and larger cooperative objectives.

modes.name: Endless Vigil
modes.description: No final round. Survive successive bosses indefinitely, vote on mutations, shop between encounters, and pursue a personal and squad streak. Solo, private and public play.

classes.name: Soldier
classes.role: Reliable ranged damage and squad leadership.
classes.lore: A former night-watch officer who refused the order to bar the infirmary doors. Mara counts everyone before she moves.

abilities.name: Rally Field
abilities.description: Allies in the field gain 20% weapon damage and 10% movement speed.

abilities.name: Precision Burst
abilities.description: Fire three accurate piercing rounds toward the aim point.

ultimate.name: Last Roll Call
ultimate.description: Reload allies instantly, clear nearby hostile projectiles once and grant 35% weapon damage in the rally field for 8 seconds.

classes.name: Heavy
classes.lore: Hux once kept the foundry running through winter. He now carries its last functioning feed motor into the streets.

abilities.name: Suppressing Cone
abilities.description: Fire fourteen rounds in a cone and slow ordinary enemies by 40%.

abilities.name: Braced Firing
abilities.description: Gain 45% damage resistance and 30% fire rate; move at 60% speed.

ultimate.name: Foundry Overture
ultimate.description: Overdrive the weapon for 6 seconds with 70% additional fire rate, two extra pierces and no magazine consumption; movement is reduced.

classes.name: Tank
classes.lore: A gate engineer carrying a door that outlived its building. Bram insists a shield is only useful with someone behind it.

abilities.name: Protective Wall
abilities.description: Place a 150-health bullet-blocking wall that allies can walk through.

abilities.name: Rescue Charge
abilities.description: Charge toward the aim point, gain brief invulnerability and damage nearby enemies.

ultimate.name: The City Holds
ultimate.description: Grant nearby allies 120 shield and 35 percentage points of armor for 8 seconds. Armor respects the global cap; identical fields do not stack.

classes.name: Medic
classes.lore: Iona wrote names on bandages when the city ran out of paper. She refuses to let the bells make those names meaningless.

abilities.name: Healing Field
abilities.description: Restore 8 health per second to allies inside the field.

abilities.name: Cleansing Serum
abilities.description: Heal nearby allies for 20 health and remove poison and slow effects.

ultimate.name: Names Returned
ultimate.description: After a one-second channel, revive nearby downed or eliminated allies according to the selected difficulty. Heal living allies for 40, cleanse effects and deal 35 damage nearby. Solo also gains 40 shield.

classes.name: Mage
classes.role: Area control and magical burst damage.
classes.lore: Sable catalogued forbidden bell harmonics before the quarantine. The cure and the curse now share the same notebook.

abilities.name: Binding Sigil
abilities.description: Damage enemies and slow ordinary enemies by 55% within a sigil.

abilities.name: Ward Detonation
abilities.description: Detonate a ward around the aim point and grant nearby allies a 35-health shield.

ultimate.name: Silent Twelfth
ultimate.description: Release three 120-damage pulses over 3 seconds, erase hostile projectiles in range on the first pulse and strongly slow ordinary enemies.

classes.name: Engineer
classes.lore: Tamsin repairs tools with parts that were never meant to fit. She believes the city can be repaired by the same method.

abilities.name: Rivet Turret
abilities.description: Deploy an 80-health turret with 25 base damage per second.

abilities.name: Deployable Barricade
abilities.description: Deploy a 120-health bullet barrier; teammates can pass through it.

ultimate.name: Impossible Machine
ultimate.description: Deploy a 200-health siege construct dealing 90 base damage per second for 14 seconds and overclock owned turrets by 50%.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.role: Precision, mobility and safe rescue openings.
classes.lore: Vale used to carry letters through streets the watch had abandoned. They still know which alleys lead home.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.description: Become untargetable by newly aimed attacks. Existing hazards still hurt.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.description: Blink toward the aim point, briefly evade damage and strike nearby enemies.

ultimate.name: Unwritten Passage
ultimate.description: For 5 seconds gain three free empowered Shadow Steps, 100% critical chance and untargetability to new aimed attacks. Existing hazards remain dangerous outside dodge invulnerability.

bosses.name: Hollow Constable
bosses.lore: A dead watch captain remembers every order except whom it was meant to protect.

signature.behavior: Patrol shuffles between locked double volleys; Cordon fires crossing flank fans and a line of arrest stamps; Lockdown pursues while releasing staggered rings with a shared escape wedge. Brutal adds a third ring in Curfew.
signature.counterplay: Move after aim locks. Cross between the Cordon fans, leave the arrest outlines, and follow the overlapping open wedge in the Lockdown rings. Casting plants his feet; successful Accords interrupt pending volleys and give a full stagger window.

bosses.artBrief: A dead watch captain remembers every order except whom it was meant to protect. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: Carrion Courier
bosses.lore: A messenger runs the same route after the streets and their names have disappeared.

signature.behavior: A single locked delivery becomes a two-leg return route at half health. Every new leg warns from the actual stop. Advanced forms add one leg and a delayed split dispatch fan.
signature.counterplay: Step sideways from each fixed charge lane, read the next arrow after the stop, and punish recovery. Wait for fading trails; the advanced dispatch fan leaves its marked central wedge clear.

bosses.artBrief: A messenger runs the same route after the streets and their names have disappeared. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: Pallbearer
bosses.lore: The coffin is empty. Its bearer keeps making room.

signature.behavior: Advance behind a resistant coffin front and moving cover, then commit to a long straight charge.
signature.counterplay: Flank the coffin, use the moving cover against volleys and attack during the charge recovery.

bosses.artBrief: The coffin is empty. Its bearer keeps making room. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: Cradle Matron
bosses.lore: An infirmary keeper shelters the dead beneath a dress sewn from bed linen.

signature.behavior: Build destructible nests that continuously summon bounded packs while slow expanding rings divide the arena.
signature.counterplay: Destroy nests to control new arrivals, clear a path through the packs and cross each ring at its visible gap.

bosses.artBrief: An infirmary keeper shelters the dead beneath a dress sewn from bed linen. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: Mold Alchemist
bosses.lore: A municipal chemist carries a garden that learned to grow without sunlight.

signature.behavior: Place warned mold pools on changing ground while aimed fans limit the route between safe patches.
signature.counterplay: Leave each landing circle before its safe window ends, and reserve a clear route to the next unmarked patch.

bosses.artBrief: A municipal chemist carries a garden that learned to grow without sunlight. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: Bellringer
bosses.lore: Every note is a warning delivered too late.

signature.behavior: Release expanding rings with a rotating timed gap while a slower spiral punishes standing still.
signature.counterplay: Follow the hollow gap marker as it rotates and cross each ring rather than trying to outrun it.

bosses.artBrief: Every note is a warning delivered too late. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: Stitchwright
bosses.lore: A surgeon of uniforms now mends the people who wore them.

signature.behavior: Catch survivors with destructible rescue tethers while hooks and crossing lanes pressure their teammates.
signature.counterplay: Shoot the outlined tether or channel its short rescue interaction; the bound survivor can still dodge and contribute.

bosses.artBrief: A surgeon of uniforms now mends the people who wore them. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: Grave Choir
bosses.lore: The singers are separate corpses. The voice beneath them is singular.

signature.behavior: Three coordinated casters offset their beam casts, leaving a readable sequence between the individual releases.
signature.counterplay: Track the three numbered caster tells and move between locked beam directions; attacks remain visible without sound.

bosses.artBrief: The singers are separate corpses. The voice beneath them is singular. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: Mortuary Engine
bosses.lore: A foundry foreman is buried inside the machine that will not let him clock out.

signature.behavior: Alternate armored firing cycles with an exposed weak point while ordered lanes and broad fans cover the floor.
signature.counterplay: Aim at the outlined weak point, use the firing gaps and save burst damage for the exposed cycle.

bosses.artBrief: A foundry foreman is buried inside the machine that will not let him clock out. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: Drowned Regent
bosses.lore: The mayor opens the floodgates for a city that no longer breathes.

signature.behavior: Shift flooded ground and relocate among harmless decoys before announcing the true ring and pool attacks.
signature.counterplay: Follow the solid true-body marker, use dry paths and wait for the relocation tell before committing a dodge.

bosses.artBrief: The mayor opens the floodgates for a city that no longer breathes. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: The Uncounted
bosses.lore: The bells remember the names the city refused to record.

signature.behavior: Combine ledger echoes, announced relocations, offset beams and bounded summons after the campaign victory is banked.
signature.counterplay: Use the persistent echo warnings and wide final ring gap, clear nearby summons and treat the extension as a separate challenge.

bosses.artBrief: The bells remember the names the city refused to record. One dominant silhouette and one signature prop; quiet matte fabric masses, restrained surface detail.

bosses.name: The Tollkeeper
bosses.lore: A corpse toll collector crouched behind one enormous coin wheel. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A corpse toll collector crouched behind one enormous coin wheel. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Roll a coin wheel down a marked lane; it banks off one wall and returns along the reflected path.
signature.counterplay: Follow the two-segment floor arrow and cross after the wheel passes.

bosses.name: Lantern Warden
bosses.lore: A tall dead lamplighter with one caged lantern and a clean triangular coat. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A tall dead lamplighter with one caged lantern and a clean triangular coat. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: One locked-origin lantern sweep with a trailing safe wedge. At half health patrol between attacks; Brutal alternates direction and adds a fully warned sequential return sweep.
signature.counterplay: Read the sweep-direction arrow, move behind the cone, and follow the new ground origin after a patrol. The final Brutal return sweep has its own complete warning and never overlaps the first.

bosses.name: Ratcatcher
bosses.lore: A hunched pest-control corpse with a large sack and hooked walking stick. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A hunched pest-control corpse with a large sack and hooked walking stick. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Three locked scent lanes release twelve bounded rats. At half health the Ratcatcher relocates before each new warning. Advanced forms finish with one/two fully warned gapped whistle rings.
signature.counterplay: Read the new ground origin after the patrol, cross between fixed scent lanes and shoot the sack to cancel a pack. Rats can navigate around cover. Follow the marked whistle gap in advanced forms; a broken sack does not silence the whistle.

bosses.name: Quarantine Clerk
bosses.lore: A thin undead clerk carrying a broad folded ledger and red sealing stamp. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A thin undead clerk carrying a broad folded ledger and red sealing stamp. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Reachable arena-relative stamp centers replace the fixed fallback grid. Intake reopens stamp I; the late Appeal Circuit patrols first and reopens stamp III after its strike. Advanced late phases add a fresh fully warned three-stamp appeal at distinct positions.
signature.counterplay: Read the ordered marks and the notched future-safe seal. Wait for its green interior before entering. Follow the new ground origin after a late patrol; advanced appeals warn a fresh set while the old safe seal expires.

bosses.name: Chain Marshal
bosses.lore: A dead gate marshal in a rectangular iron coat carrying two heavy chains. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A dead gate marshal in a rectangular iron coat carrying two heavy chains. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Anchor two chains to wall sockets and sweep the marked sectors once before the anchors break.
signature.counterplay: Stand in either unswept quadrant or destroy an anchor to widen the gap.

bosses.name: Gate Widow
bosses.lore: A mourning corpse whose veil is a single large gate-shaped iron frame. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A mourning corpse whose veil is a single large gate-shaped iron frame. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Close two portcullis lanes while raising the third; rotate the open lane after each cast.
signature.counterplay: Use the plainly outlined open lane and wait for the next audible latch cue.

bosses.name: Black Ambulance
bosses.lore: A horse-shaped mortuary ambulance fused to its skeletal driver and one bell. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A horse-shaped mortuary ambulance fused to its skeletal driver and one bell. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Circle the perimeter, stop at a marked station, then charge a straight rescue lane.
signature.counterplay: Avoid the telegraphed destination; the stationary recovery exposes the driver.

bosses.name: Glass Surgeon
bosses.lore: A slender corpse surgeon with one transparent glass arm and an ivory apron. The quarantine left its work unfinished.
bosses.artBrief: A slender corpse surgeon with one transparent glass arm and an ivory apron. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Place four glass needles that connect into a temporary polygon with one deliberately missing edge.
signature.counterplay: Leave through the missing edge before the outlined polygon activates.

signature.behavior: Eject slow loaves that split once into two clearly announced crumbs after landing.
signature.counterplay: Step away from the landing circles and the two marked split directions.

signature.behavior: Open alternating channels that push players sideways without dealing damage; bullets still require dodging.

signature.counterplay: Leave the fixed marked circles; warning icons show the target lock has ended.

signature.counterplay: Exit through the opening rather than crossing the ink stroke after it hardens.

bosses.artBrief: A corpse icehouse keeper in a pale square coat carrying a large cold-iron tongs. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Freeze three marked floor strips, creating bounded sideways sliding only while players choose to stand there.
signature.counterplay: Use the dry strips; dodge remains responsive and never adds uncontrolled momentum.

signature.behavior: Place two temporary bridges across explicitly marked dangerous water bands, then alternate which bridge remains open.
signature.counterplay: Follow the open bridge arrow; all ground stays traversable with a safe outer bypass.

bosses.artBrief: A dead mourner under one large cracked porcelain mask and smooth ivory funeral cloth. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Shed four large mask fragments that act as moving cover; each fragment cracks before becoming a radial hazard.
signature.counterplay: Use cover during its intact state and move away from the clearly cracking fragment.

signature.behavior: Charge pressure through three visible valves; turning any valve vents a safe wedge.
signature.counterplay: Hold one neutral valve briefly, or take the always-available marked outer gap.

bosses.artBrief: A tall funeral corpse carrying a single oval silvered coffin lid. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Show one non-damaging reflection that copies a previous boss position; the real body retains its black foot marker.
signature.counterplay: Use the persistent body marker and distinct hollow reflection outline; no invisible collision or surprise damage.

bosses.artBrief: An undead survey judge with a broad black slate and one oversized chalk hand. Dry ink contour and matte gouache; one clear prop, broad quiet fabric shapes, three grouped value masses. No particle cloud or dense all-over filigree.

signature.behavior: Draw a rectangle around a marked region, then erase one wall before the other three flash.
signature.counterplay: Cross the erased wall during the long warning; no player is trapped by solid collision.

signature.behavior: Pluck parallel strings in a fixed low-middle-high sequence, showing the next string with a thick dashed outline.
signature.counterplay: Move between the numbered lanes; audio has a matching visual countdown.

signature.behavior: Call three geometric bird flocks along crossing trails; the flocks have discrete silhouettes rather than particle swarms.
signature.counterplay: Read the three dashed paths and cross after their leading bird passes.

signature.behavior: Attach a visible paper seal to a player; walking through a neutral cleansing circle removes its slow before expiration.
signature.counterplay: Use either cleansing circle or let the bounded slow expire; there is no stolen permanent currency or unavoidable damage.

signature.counterplay: Pass through either gate and use an Accord pad to hold the next step briefly.

signature.behavior: Anchor to three pylons and pull a marked floor section; breaking one pylon creates a shared damage opening.
signature.counterplay: Destroy any pylon or use the unobstructed outer lane; pylon health scales with roster.

signature.behavior: Expose three rib weak points sequentially while the body moves along a predictable wide curve.
signature.counterplay: Attack the numbered exposed rib and stay outside the thick body outline.

signature.behavior: Three keepers take turns casting; striking the highlighted keeper interrupts one crossing beam.
signature.counterplay: Track the single highlighted caster; a fixed safe gap remains even without an interrupt.

signature.counterplay: Use a neutral valve or maintain damage from the guaranteed open side; no particular class is required.

signature.behavior: Four attendants carry the throne along visible waypoints; defeating one lowers the throne for an opening.

signature.behavior: Mark two bite lanes and leave one broad escape corridor; destroyed temporary walls expose the core.
signature.counterplay: Use the unmarked corridor and the long recovery; static arena exits never disappear.

signature.counterplay: Use either shelter or steer outward; solo needs only one pad and normal dodge remains available.

signature.counterplay: Remember the dashed replay paths or use the persistent safe flank.

signature.behavior: Breakable ticket stands release staggered aisle volleys. Dismissal crosses the rows; Final Call adds a second sweep while the usher walks between calls.
signature.counterplay: Read the locked rays and cross after a volley, or destroy a ticket stand to cancel every pending shot from that stand.

bosses.artBrief: Still seats visitors in a hall no one can find. Preserve the issued original concept and complete motion poses.

bosses.artBrief: The abandoned fountain learned to drink the rain. Preserve the issued original concept and complete motion poses.

signature.counterplay: Use the quiet center, steer against the marked arrows or break a cloth pin to remove its wind. Dodge briefly suppresses wind force.

bosses.artBrief: Its tether still pulls above a deserted street. Preserve the issued original concept and complete motion poses.

signature.behavior: A slow collision-resolved glide lays locked warned wax rails. Twin Wick adds parallel rails with a quiet center and faster lateral movement.
signature.counterplay: Leave the marked wake before it burns, cross after it cools, or use the quiet center between twin rails. Masonry stops the wake.

bosses.artBrief: A single light still travels the cemetery path. Preserve the selected original motion, permanent identity marks and complete defeat poses.

bosses.artBrief: The street gathers its loose stones at the sound of footsteps. Preserve the selected original motion, permanent identity marks and complete defeat poses.

signature.counterplay: Sidestep the warning, cross after steam ends or break a finite remote valve to cancel its linked pour and beads. Preserve a cold route.

bosses.artBrief: It keeps the last tea warm for guests who never returned. Preserve the selected original motion, permanent identity marks and complete defeat poses.

leaderboards.status: Stage 1 specification; no online implementation or service deployment is implied
leaderboards.teamRankPolicy: Every combat participant shares the one team-run rank. Personal contributions never establish individual ranks.

periods.all: All qualifying terminal runs within the selected release season and exact content revision.

week.explicitWeekStart: YYYY-MM-DD Monday; reject any other weekday or time zone.

seasons.contentPolicy: Exact content revision partitions scores. Preserve older seasons as archives; never silently merge balance revisions.

rosterPolicy.identity: Server-minted opaque run-scoped UUID; a reconnect retains its original participantId.
rosterPolicy.admission: Only at encounter boundaries. Spectators and lobby-only visitors are excluded.
rosterPolicy.finalEligibleRoster: Union of every unique participant admitted into combat from the first encounter through the scored clear. Departures, kicks, and eliminations never remove members.
rosterPolicy.survivorsAtFinalClear: Eligible participants alive, connected and admitted to combat at the authoritative base final-clear tick.
rosterPolicy.peakCombatRoster: Maximum concurrent admitted combat slots at any encounter start, including downed, eliminated and reconnect-reserved slots.
rosterPolicy.lateJoinCredit: Same team rank, with encounter entry/range, participation and final-state context.

timed.eligibleOutcome: Completed required base encounters; each clears before its own deadline; at least one connected living survivor.
timed.formula: roundHalfUp(500000 + 250000 * clamp(1 - combatMs / deadlineBudgetMs, 0, 1) + 150000 * survivorsAtFinalClear / finalEligibleRoster + 100000 * clamp(1 - hpDamageTaken / summedPlayerMaxHealthAtEncounterStarts, 0, 1))
timed.rounding: Round complete nonnegative sum once: floor(x + 0.5). Use exact integer-ratio arithmetic at rounding boundaries.

finalEligibleRoster.meaning: All unique participants ever admitted into scored combat; departures remain eligible.

timed.healthDamage: Actual HP removed, including hostile/environmental/self-damage; cap each hit at remaining HP. Exclude shield depletion, blocked damage, max-health-stat changes and overkill; healing never subtracts damage.
timed.healthBudget: Sum effective maximum HP once per admitted entrant per scored encounter start. Revives/reconnects/shields never add extra budget.
timed.deadlineBudget: Sum frozen per-encounter authored deadlines after legal difficulty/mutation adjustments; validate every individual clear.
timed.clock: Active simulation from first combat through base final clear, including telegraphs/Accord/phase invulnerability. Exclude all noncombat phases.
timed.secretPolicy: Finalize and bank base campaign rank before optional Uncounted. Secret result is a badge and cannot alter base score.

endless.clock: Only active combat ticks; freeze rank tuple after each completed boss. Show total active survival including final failed encounter.

finalEligibleRoster.meaning: All historical admitted combat participants; can exceed 50 because peak concurrency is separate.

endless.partialEncounterPolicy: Additional survival/damage after last clear stays in recap but cannot improve the ranking tuple.

ties.ratioComparison: Cross-multiply with arbitrary-precision integers; never compare rounded display percentages.

rankedEligibility.trustedSource: Official authoritative Render combat server authenticated to the Sites HTTP service.
rankedEligibility.privateOptIn: Explicit before first combat, disclosed to every lobby participant: results and nicknames become public; private room code remains private.
rankedEligibility.accessibility: Aim assist, auto-fire, remapping, touch, gamepad and reduced effects remain ranked-compatible.

storage.migrationPolicy: Append versioned schema-only migrations; no runtime CREATE/ALTER.

runs.index: Exact board partition, competitive keys, terminal time

participants.fields: Public roster fields plus private admission counters; never reconnect secrets.

storage.mutationAtomicity: One D1 batch with constrained compare-and-set, event idempotency and all participant deltas. Failed state/owner/sequence checks must abort dependent writes.
storage.rankedContentRegistry: Server configuration allowlists exact protocol/content/rules/season combinations; requests cannot create trusted combinations.

exactRatioIndex.formula: BigInt floor(numerator * 10^33 / denominator), left-pad to 49 decimal digits
exactRatioIndex.proof: Any two distinct permitted fractions differ by at least 1/(2^53-1)^2; scaling by 10^33 separates them by more than 12, preserving exact ordering after floor. Equal fractions produce equal keys.
exactRatioIndex.indexPolicy: Use this key in the competitive ordering index and RANK window. Never SQLite floating division or rounded percentages.

authentication.canonicalRequest: UPPERCASE_METHOD + LF + PATH + LF + timestamp + LF + nonce + LF + SHA256_HEX(exactBodyBytes)
authentication.pathPolicy: No writer query strings. Sign the normalized literal /api/v1/ path.
authentication.verification: Web Crypto verify; configured official key/server allowlist; never keys from a request body.
authentication.rotation: Current key plus one configured previous key for a 24-hour transition.

http.numericPolicy: All counters are nonnegative safe integers. Positive denominators and validated enum values. Reject NaN, infinity, booleans-as-integers and unknown keys.

errors.400: Invalid shape, enum, numeric range or board combination

semanticValidation: Participant display names also require NFC/trim/grapheme/UTF-8/control checks; JSON Schema length alone is insufficient.
survivorsAtFinalClear <= min(finalEligibleRoster, peakCombatRoster); finalEligibleRoster equals registered historical roster count.
peakCombatRoster <= mode capacity and <= finalEligibleRoster. Derive the band; reject any caller-provided different band.
combatMs == floor(combatTicks * 1000 / 30); use arbitrary-precision integer intermediate products.
For Endless, totalCombatSurvivalTicks >= combatThroughLastClearTicks; both derived ms values must agree with ticks.
Every required individual timed encounter clears strictly before its frozen deadline; aggregate combatMs alone is insufficient evidence.
Timed final metrics are accepted only for timed modes and exact required encounter count; Endless metrics only for endless mode with >=1 clear.
Cumulative damage, elapsed combat, health budget, clears, roster count and peak cannot decrease across registered events.
Last-clear metrics freeze at the latest acknowledged clear and must match final Endless metrics.
Every participant delta uses an admitted run-scoped ID, valid class IDs, nondecreasing contribution totals and legal encounter bounds.
finalize terminalReason base-clear is valid only for timed clears; other terminal reasons are valid only for Endless global entries.
Run/event UUIDs are lowercase UUIDv4. Private checkpoint digests are never public API fields.
Week membership uses the signed authoritative terminal time; idempotent retries do not move a result between weeks.

combat-start.precondition: registered or intermission; exact current sequence/digest/owner; roster durably registered
combat-start.effect: Set phase combat before simulating any tick; keep checkpoint sequence; refresh owner lease.

intermission.precondition: combat clear or intermission bounded roster registration; exact current sequence/digest/owner
intermission.effect: Set intermission; increment checkpoint sequence; replace digest; preserve monotonic counters.

lease-refresh.precondition: Nonterminal eligible run; exact current sequence/digest/owner
lease-refresh.effect: Set owner lease expiry to service now + 90 seconds. No gameplay/sequence change.

restore-claim.precondition: Latest acknowledged intermission digest; the official server validates the signed checkpoint and <=24h lifetime before requesting the claim; prior 90-second lease expired; exact sequence/digest.
restore-claim.effect: Atomically increment ownerEpoch and replace server ownership. No counter/seed/offer reroll; one claimant wins.

demote.effect: Latch verificationState unverified or practice. Never allow later promotion.

finalize.precondition: Current owner, exact sequence/state/digest; completed timed clear or terminal endless with >=1 clear; all participants durably registered
finalize.effect: Compute derived score/band/rank keys; atomically mark terminal and persist one immutable result.

checkpointIntegrity.rankedRecovery: Only exact latest durable intermission, atomically claimed by one owner after lease expiry; no finished run, old sequence or active-combat replay.
checkpointIntegrity.midCombatCrashRecovery: Resume signed prior checkpoint as Recovery Practice. Cannot erase failed partial combat for a better verified result.
checkpointIntegrity.idempotentFinalize: Same run/event/payload hash returns original result with no second row. Conflicting payload or terminal replay is 409.
checkpointIntegrity.serviceFailure: Continue gameplay. Latch unverified if a required registration cannot be acknowledged; never block offline/LAN gameplay.
checkpointIntegrity.unknownFinalizeResponse: Pending verification; owning official server retries exact event with fresh transport nonce for <=24h. Lost unacknowledged payload never becomes an invented rank.
checkpointIntegrity.leaseTransfer: No early-release endpoint in v1. A replacement owner waits for the 90-second lease to expire; planned shutdown can stop refreshing it.

ui.mobile: Two-line rows; explicit expand button; no horizontal scrolling.
ui.rtl: Mirror menus while preserving rank/number direction and isolating nicknames.
